steps.step_name: Coordinate with teams to ensure process steps are followed
Request resubmission of correct information from students when details are missing or incorrect

exceptions.impact: Causes delays by a few hours or even a day and creates back-and-forth emails
exceptions.recovery: Request the student to resubmit the correct information via email
Ask students to provide the needed details or documents

steps.step_name: Coordinate with teams to ensure process steps are followed
Coordinate with teams on incident progress
Review logs and update incident statuses manually when needed

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Miscommunication about incident progress and status updates not done correctly
exceptions.impact: Requires extra time to review logs and update them manually, around 30 minutes to an hour each time; occurs a couple of times a week
exceptions.recovery: Review logs and update incident statuses manually
